dates.treatment: timestamps kept as naive wall-clock values; no UTC offset applied

geometry.notes: The source geometry file does not provide values for the river-bed depth or delta_h.

notes: Raw CSV files are copied from flipoyo/MOLONARI1D without data cleaning or resampling.
Pressure input is already in volts and is processed with the P606 pressure calibration.
The historical period field states 200 days, 6:35:00; the exported first/last timestamps span approximately 200 days.
Temperature calibration beta and v_ref are not used for this source because all four temperature channels and the stream temperature are already expressed in degrees Celsius.
